case_text: SYNTHETIC CASE (fictional). 70-year-old woman with known COPD and hypertension. 3 days of worse breathlessness, needs 3 pillows to sleep, ankle swelling. Raised jugular venous pressure, bibasal crackles, mild wheeze, pitting oedema to the knees. NT-proBNP markedly raised. Chest X-ray: enlarged heart and upper-lobe vessel prominence. Afebrile, sputum unchanged.
evidence_topics: acute heart failure diagnosis and diuretic treatment

must_catch.why: COPD exacerbation is a real alternative and wheeze is present.

must_not_claim.why: Congestion needs treatment of the congestion.
